verdict.rationale: Highnote documents API-driven card issuance and says cards can be created and managed, including virtual, physical, and tokenized cards (docs-1, docs-17, docs-27). It also says cards close automatically when an agent workflow ends (docs-17), which touches the close step of the lifecycle. Missing for 10: any evidence of activate, pause/suspend, unpause, report lost or stolen, or reissue with a linked replacement; explicit API mutations for closing a card permanently; and independent or hands-on corroboration.
